evidence: Library shows 6 templates, each with author (e.g. Sarah Chen) and description (e.g. "A clean, modern resume template perfect for job applications...").
Card "Professional Resume": category badge Resume, scenario badge Business, author Sarah Chen, 1,250 uses, Updated 2024-12-01, plus title and description.
Clicking "Use Template" opened dialog "Professional Resume" with badges, description, author, uses, and a "Fill Template" tab containing 14 fields.

With empty form, banner reads "Required fields missing — Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, Professional Summary, Company Name, Position, Start Date, Responsibilities, Degree, School, Graduation Year, Skills" and the "Preview Result" tab is [disabled].
All 14 fields of the Resume template (12 required + Phone, End Date) accepted typed values and retained them in the form.

After filling fields the "Preview Result" tab enabled and shows substituted values: h1 "Jane Doe", "Tech Corp — Senior Developer", "B.S. Computer Science — MIT, 2018", Skills "JavaScript, React, Node.js".

Built-in Markdown resume preview: h1/h2/h3 headings, strong ("Software Engineer", "B.S. Computer Science"), emphasis ("Jan 2020 - Present"), a separator (hr), and paragraph line breaks all rendered; no unresolved {{placeholders}} remain.

issue: Declared-format field (Email) accepts invalid value with no validation
actual: Email field (placeholder john@example.com) was filled with "not-an-email". No error was shown, the "Required fields missing" banner cleared, the Preview Result tab became enabled, and the preview rendered the line "Software Engineer | not-an-email | +1 555 010 2030".

evidence:
"Copy to Clipboard" wrote raw Markdown (template's declared format) captured via patched clipboard.writeText: "# Jane Doe

**Software Engineer** | ... ## Skills
JavaScript, React, Node.js", and toast "Copied to clipboard! The generated content has been copied." appeared.

Setting required Full Name to whitespace-only ("   ") re-disabled the Preview Result tab and restored the banner "Please fill in: Full Name"; restoring a value re-enabled it. (Format validity is tracked separately under CS-14.)

issue: Markdown emphasis/heading characters are not rejected or neutralized, altering generated formatting
actual:
The app blocks < > { } [ ] \ | ` (error "Special characters like < > { } [ ] \ | ` are not allowed"), but accepts *, #, -. Entering Full Name = "## Evil **Bold** --- Heading" passed validation, preview enabled, and the output rendered as

## Evil Bold --- Heading

— the injected ** created a element not present in the template, altering generated Markdown formatting.

evidence: Category=Resume → "Showing 1 of 6", only Professional Resume. Scenario=Academic → "Showing 1 of 6", only Academic Research Summary. Sorts verified against data: Most Popular (1250→340 uses), Recently Updated (2024-12-05→2024-09-30), Oldest First (createdAt 2024-01-08→2024-05-12), Alphabetical (Academic…→Weekly…).

Typing "resu" (>2 chars) rendered a real-time suggestion dropdown containing a "Professional Resume" button; clicking it set the search box to "Professional Resume" and narrowed results to "Showing 1 of 6" with only that card.

issue: Search is exact-substring only; no typo tolerance or fuzzy matching
actual: Single-character typos of existing keywords all yield "Showing 0 of 6 templates" / "No templates found" with no suggestions: "resmue", "resme", "resune", "reusme" (vs "Resume"), "meting", "meetng" (vs "Meeting"), "weekli" (vs "Weekly"). Correct spelling "resu" matches fine, confirming only literal substring matching is implemented.

evidence: In favorites-only view (2 favorites), search "professional" returned only the favorited "Professional Resume" (not the non-favorited "Professional Email"); category filter = Meeting Minutes returned only "Meeting Minutes". Both stayed scoped to favorites.

Heart on Professional Resume and Meeting Minutes added both (Favorites badge 1→2, storage ["1","3"]); header "Favorites" toggle opened a favorites-only list showing exactly those 2. Unfavoriting Meeting Minutes removed it (badge → 1, list → only Professional Resume).

On favoriting, heart svg class changed to "lucide-heart w-4 h-4 fill-current" with computed fill rgb(242,147,13) and header badge incremented 0→1→2 instantly. Unfavoriting reverted the icon, decremented badge to 1, and removed the card from the favorites list — all without reload.

All controls updated results and the "Showing X of 6" count in-place at URL http://localhost:6089/ with no navigation: search ("re"→5, "professional"→1), category (Resume→1), scenario (Academic→1), favorites-only toggle (→2), and all four sort orders re-ordered the grid live.

Submitted "QA Daily Standup" with title, author "QA Bot", description, category Other, scenario Business, Markdown content, and one defined field ("Team Name" → {{team_name}}). Library grew from 6 to 7 entries.

Immediately after submit (no reload, URL unchanged), the sidebar count went "Showing 6 of 6" → "Showing 7 of 7" and a new card "QA Daily Standup / QA Bot / 0 uses / Updated 2026-08-27" appeared in the grid.

Submitting the fully empty form left the dialog open and library at 6 (no template created). Filling title, author, description and content but defining zero fields was also blocked (library still 6). Submission only succeeded once ≥1 field was defined. Note: blocking is silent — no inline error or toast is shown.

The submitted "QA Daily Standup" card appears in the library; clicking "Use Template" opened its dialog (author QA Bot, 0 uses) with its declared "Team Name" field, and the Preview Result tab rendered the content as

Standup Notes

No dynamic fields here.

.

issue: No bidirectional field↔placeholder validation; previews render unresolved placeholders
actual: Both directions accepted. (a) "QA Daily Standup" submitted with declared field {{team_name}} while content contained no placeholder at all. (b) "QA Plain Note" submitted with content containing {{ticket_id}} that maps to no declared field; its preview renders the literal unresolved text "Ticket reference: {{ticket_id}}". No validation error was shown in either case.

issue: Duplicate field labels are neither rejected nor disambiguated; fields are not independently fillable
actual: Two fields labeled "Name" (placeholders "Alice" and "Bob") were both accepted and submitted, both assigned the same id "name" / {{name}}. In the use dialog, typing "Alice Smith" into the first Name input simultaneously set the second input to "Alice Smith" — they share one value and cannot be filled independently. React duplicate-key console errors were also emitted.

evidence: Plain-text template "QA Plain Note" previews inside <pre class="whitespace-pre-wrap"> preserving the 4-space indent and line breaks, with {{name}} substituted to "Alice Smith". Markdown templates (built-in Resume, custom "QA Daily Standup") render as real h1/h2/h3, strong, em and hr elements after substitution.

After reloading http://localhost:6089/, the library shows "Showing 8 of 8" including both custom templates ("QA Daily Standup", "QA Plain Note"). The Favorites badge still reads 1 and the favorites-only view shows "Professional Resume" with a filled heart (fill-current), persisted via localStorage.
